name: sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu
title: Muse Spark Open measured on one TPU v7 host with SGLang
summary: SGLang-TorchTPU runs Muse Spark Open, an 816B mixture-of-experts model, on a single TPU v7 host. On SemiAnalysis AgentX, the latest work shows about 3x faster decode at small batch with a custom megakernel and DFlash2, 18% faster decode at 500K-token context, twice the context per chip with fp8 KV, and up to 77% more agent throughput with HiCache and session-aware eviction.

appearances.title: SGLang-TorchTPU brings SGLang serving to Google TPUs
appearances.summary: SGLang-TorchTPU is an open TPU plugin for SGLang built with Google and Meta on top of the newly open-sourced TorchTPU backend, serving open models such as Muse Spark Open, GLM-5.3 Flash and Kimi K3 on TPU; the team reports a custom MegaKernel reaching 770 tok/s decode at batch 1 for Muse Spark Open.
